mapper.sql: CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM subject_permission user_deny WHERE user_deny.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND user_deny.target_type = 'USER' AND user_deny.target_corp_code = e.corp_code AND user_deny.target_id = e.ding_user_id AND user_deny.permission_effect = 'DENY' AND user_deny.status = 'ENABLED' AND user_deny.deleted = 0 ) THEN 0 WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM subject_permission user_allow WHERE user_allow.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND user_allow.target_type = 'USER' AND user_allow.target_corp_code = e.corp_code AND user_allow.target_id = e.ding_user_id AND user_allow.permission_effect = 'ALLOW' AND user_allow.status = 'ENABLED' AND user_allow.deleted = 0 ) THEN 1 WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM invoice_subject s WHERE s.id = #{subjectId} AND s.all_employee_visible = 1 AND s.deleted = 0 ) THEN 1 WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM subject_permission department_allow INNER JOIN ding_employee_department employee_department ON employee_department.employee_id = e.id INNER JOIN ding_department employee_department_directory ON employee_department_directory.id = employee_department.department_id AND employee_department_directory.status = 'ENABLED' WHERE department_allow.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND department_allow.target_type = 'DEPARTMENT' AND department_allow.target_corp_code = employee_department_directory.corp_code AND department_allow.target_id = employee_department_directory.ding_department_id AND department_allow.permission_effect = 'ALLOW' AND department_allow.status = 'ENABLED' AND department_allow.deleted = 0 ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

WHERE e.status = 'ACTIVE' AND e.corp_code = #{corpCode}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ding_employee_department direct_membership INNER JOIN ding_department member_department ON member_department.id = direct_membership.department_id AND member_department.status = 'ENABLED' WHERE direct_membership.employee_id = e.id AND direct_membership.department_id = #{departmentId} AND member_department.corp_code = e.corp_code )
AND (LOWER(e.employee_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(e.employee_no) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(e.department_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR e.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND () = 10
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ding_employee e LEFT JOIN ding_department d ON d.id = e.department_id

SELECT id, corp_code, corp_name, corp_id, ding_user_id, union_id, employee_no, employee_name, department_id, department_name, mobile, status, last_synced_at, updated_at FROM ding_employee WHERE corp_code = #{corpCode} AND ding_user_id = #{dingUserId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT id, corp_code, corp_name, corp_id, ding_user_id, union_id, employee_no, employee_name, department_id, department_name, mobile, status, last_synced_at, updated_at FROM ding_employee WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT id, corp_code, corp_name, corp_id, ding_user_id, employee_no, employee_name, department_id, department_name, mobile, status, updated_at FROM ding_employee WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND id IN #{id} ORDER BY employee_no ASC, id ASC

SELECT d.corp_code, MAX(d.corp_name) AS corp_name FROM ding_department d WHERE d.status = 'ENABLED' AND d.corp_code IS NOT NULL AND d.corp_code != '' GROUP BY d.corp_code ORDER BY MAX(d.corp_name) ASC, d.corp_code ASC

SELECT d.id, d.corp_code, d.corp_name, d.corp_id, d.ding_department_id, d.department_name, d.parent_department_id, d.status, d.sort_no, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) FROM ding_employee_department ed INNER JOIN ding_employee e ON e.id = ed.employee_id AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE ed.department_id = d.id) AS employee_count, d.updated_at FROM ding_department d
ORDER BY d.sort_no ASC, d.id ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT d.id, d.corp_code, d.corp_name, d.corp_id, d.ding_department_id, d.department_name, d.parent_department_id, d.status, d.sort_no, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) FROM ding_employee_department ed INNER JOIN ding_employee e ON e.id = ed.employee_id AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE ed.department_id = d.id) AS employee_count, d.updated_at FROM ding_department d WHERE d.status = 'ENABLED' AND d.id IN #{id} ORDER BY d.sort_no ASC, d.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ding_department (corp_code, corp_name, corp_id, ding_department_id, department_name, parent_department_id, status, sort_no, last_synced_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{corpCode}, #{corpName}, #{corpId}, #{dingDepartmentId}, #{departmentName}, #{parentDepartmentId}, #{status}, #{sortNo}, #{lastSyncedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE ding_department SET corp_name = #{corpName}, corp_id = #{corpId}, department_name = #{departmentName}, parent_department_id = #{parentDepartmentId}, status = #{status}, sort_no = #{sortNo}, last_synced_at = #{lastSyncedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ding_employee (corp_code, corp_name, corp_id, ding_user_id, union_id, employee_no, employee_name, department_id, department_name, mobile, status, last_synced_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{corpCode}, #{corpName}, #{corpId}, #{dingUserId}, #{unionId}, #{employeeNo}, #{employeeName}, #{departmentId}, #{departmentName}, #{mobile}, #{status}, #{lastSyncedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE ding_employee SET corp_name = #{corpName}, corp_id = #{corpId}, union_id = #{unionId}, employee_no = #{employeeNo}, employee_name = #{employeeName}, department_id = #{departmentId}, department_name = #{departmentName}, mobile = #{mobile}, status = #{status}, last_synced_at = #{lastSyncedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ding_employee_department (employee_id, department_id, is_primary, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{departmentId}, #{primary}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO ding_directory_sync_log (trigger_type, status, department_count, employee_count, operator_name, error_message, started_at, finished_at) VALUES (#{triggerType}, #{status}, #{departmentCount}, #{employeeCount}, #{operatorName}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt})
